Method of Attack: Pretends to be the popular Pokemon Go bot application NecroBot to trick users into downloading it
Encrypts victim's files using AES encryption and appends _nullbyte extension
Steals entered credentials by uploading them to command and control server
Terminates processes like chrome, cmd, taskmgr, firefox, iexplore, and opera to hinder removal or searching for help
Generates and uploads screenshots of active Windows screens to command and control server
Demands 0.1 bitcoins ransom to decrypt files
Attack Vector: Distributed via a fake Github project pretending to be a rebuilt version of NecroBot application
User downloads and executes fake NecroBot application
